title: Mitochondrial Oxygen Consumption Assay
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rrud56w
materials: Mitochondrial Assay Solution (MAS): 115 mM KCl (Sigma P9333), 10 mM KH2PO4 (Sigma P9791), 2 mM MgCl2 (Sigma M1028), 3 mM HEPES (Sigma H0887), 1mM EGTA (Sigma E4378), FA-free BSA 0.2% (A7511), adjust solution to pH 7.2 using 5N KOH.CAUTIONS: The presence of BSA in the MAS solution preserves mitochondrial coupling. It is essential to have a concentration of 0.2% BSA in the MAS solution.

Injection compounds: Port A: 2.5 – 20 mM ADP (Sigma A2754); Port B: 40 µM Oligomycin (Sigma O4876); Port C: 2.5 - 320 µM BAM 15(Tim Tec ST056388)/ 40 - 160 µM FCCP (Sigma C2920); Port D: 20 µM Antimycin A (Sigma A8674) and Rotenone (Sigma R8875).TIPS: ADP can be prepared as 100mM stock in MAS solution and adjusted to pH 7.2. Other injection compounds can be prepared at 1000X in DMSO and diluted to 10X with MAS for port loading. The final concentration in the well after injection is 1X concentration.

Complex I Assay Media: 11 mM Pyruvate (Sigma P2256), 11 mM malate (Sigma M1000), 11 mM L-proline (Sigma P0380), pH 7.2.TIPS: Pyruvate, malate and L- proline can be prepared as 100 mM stock in MAS solution and adjusted to pH 7.2. The substrates can then be diluted to the desired concentration (11 mM) with MAS.EQUIPMENT
Preparation of Mitochondrial Complex I Assay Plate

steps.title: Prepare Mitochondrial Isolation Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare isolation buffer consisting of 154 mM KCl and 1 mM EDTA, adjusted to pH 7.4.

steps.title: Collect and Wash Larvae
steps.instruction: Collect 10 whole wandering third instar larvae (including males and females) and wash them in water and 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Place larvae in 100 µL of ice-cold mitochondrial isolation buffer in 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Homogenize Larvae
steps.instruction: Gently homogenize the third instar larvae or thoraces using a plastic microtube pestle.

substeps.instruction: Perform 80 strokes up and down, pressing the dounce straight up and down without grinding.
If a pellet forms during homogenization, release it with a spatula or pipette tip and continue.

steps.title: Filter Homogenate
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate to remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the homogenate into a 1-cc syringe containing 200 µL of isolation buffer.
Force the homogenate through the gauze filter and collect in a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Isolate Mitochondria via Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered homogenate at 1500 x g at 4°C for 8 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Remove and discard the cloudy supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Wash the pellet with 200 µL of mitochondrial isolation buffer.
Resuspend the pellet in 20 µL of isolation buffer.

steps.title: Quantify Mitochondrial Protein
steps.instruction: Perform a Bradford assay (Sigma B9616) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

substeps.instruction: To ensure readings are within the standard curve range, dilute 2 µL of mitochondrial stock with 10 µL of mitochondrial isolation buffer (1 to 6 dilutions).

steps.title: Hydrate XF Sensor Cartridge
steps.instruction: Hydrate the XF sensor cartridge at 23°C overnight in XF calibration buffer the day before the assay.

steps.title: Load and Calibrate XF Cartridge
steps.instruction: On the day of the assay, load the XF sensor cartridge injection ports with compounds and calibrate the cartridge following the XF instrument protocol.

steps.title: Dilute Mitochondrial Stock
steps.instruction: Dilute the mitochondrial stock solution with MAS to a final concentration of 0.02 - 0.4 µg/µL.

substeps.instruction: Gently pipette to mix the mitochondria.
Perform 1 to 6 dilutions with MAS to form a final volume of ~100 µL (lower concentrations may only require 1 to 3 dilutions).
Add this to a larger volume to reach the desired final concentration.

steps.title: Plate Mitochondria
steps.instruction: Pipette 50 µL of the diluted mitochondria into each well of an XF cell culture microplate (e.g., 0.1, 0.2, and 0.4 µg/µL concentrations result in 5, 10, and 20 µg total mitochondria per well).

steps.title: Adhere Mitochondria to Plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the XF cell culture microplate at 2254 x g at 4°C for 20 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Visualize the mitochondria under a microscope using 20X magnification.
Note any wells that do not have a 'monolayer' of mitochondria adhered to the bottom.

steps.title: Incubate with Assay Media
steps.instruction: Add 450 µL of complex I assay media to each well and incubate the microplate at 23°C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Run XF Instrument Protocol
steps.instruction: Exchange the calibration plate with the cell culture microplate and follow the instrument controller instructions to complete the XF instrument protocol.

description: Transfer 50µL of MAS into each background correction wells.
